summary: Results‑driven and business‑oriented professional with strong experience in business operations, full‑cycle human resources, and administrative management. Proven ability to execute a wide range of business management, administrative and practical strategies that streamline operations, increase production, optimize workforce, and improve employee retention.

experience.title: Senior HR Manager
responsibilities: Managed all aspects of daily HR operations for a multi‑location organization with a supervisory scope of 6 staff.
Oversaw employee relations, performance evaluations, progressive discipline, mediation, and grievance procedures.
Ensured proper staffing ratios based on patient census and tracked workforce turnover.
Coached staff, led training and development initiatives, and developed HR policies.
Handled full‑cycle recruiting, new hire orientation, and unemployment/claims administration.
Prepared financial statements, managed budgets, and coordinated tax filings with CPA.
Oversaw payroll processing via ADP, including wage assignments, garnishments, and bonus calculations.
Implemented and maintained HRIS system and managed benefits enrollment and 401(k) administration.
Coordinated employee relations activities, safety committee participation, and compliance reporting (FMLA, EEO, OSHA, COBRA, etc.).

experience.title: Executive Assistant III
responsibilities: Provided administrative support to two senior executives, managing calendars, itineraries, and agendas.
Maintained customer master database and organized logistics for meetings and conferences.
Researched and booked travel arrangements, handled invoicing, accounts receivable/payable, and bookkeeping.
Facilitated inventory control, purchasing of supplies, and maintained purchase order logs.
Coordinated expense reports, archived files, and performed general office management duties.

experience.title: Human Resources Coordinator
responsibilities: Provided HR support to multiple facilities, including office procedures and policy implementation.
Handled recruiting, personnel file maintenance, employment verifications, and payroll processing.
Reduced payroll errors to less than 3% and administered benefits, I‑9 paperwork, and FMLA/COBRA claims.
Maintained license renewals for LVN and physicians and managed special HR projects.

experience.title: Financial Operations Assistant
responsibilities: Performed data entry, filing, and document retrieval for federal criminal prosecutions and civil cases.
Managed invoices, authorized payments, and maintained contract files.
Prepared travel authorizations, monitored stock levels, and provided customer service to vendors.
Balanced accounting records and assisted with financial reporting.
